context: Steady incompressible turbulent flow: two-dimensional turbulent flow over a backward-facing step with a contraction (pitzDaily), RANS k-epsilon model, inlet velocity 15 m/s. Solved with OpenFOAM simpleFoam using SIMPLEC (consistent) pressure-velocity coupling; with SIMPLEC, pressure under-relaxation factors close to 1 are usually tolerated. The run stops once every equation residual is below its convergence target. Goal: reach convergence in as few iterations as possible without oscillation or divergence. The momentum (U) under-relaxation factor acts like a pseudo time step: larger values give faster progress but less stability. The turbulence equations' factor is moved together with the momentum factor.
